title: SEC6: cert-pinned TLS retains handshake sig verification
description: PinnedCertVerifier in xcid_client.rs bypasses CA chain validation (correct for self-signed certs in a private transit peering network) but explicitly delegates verify_tls12_signature and verify_tls13_signature to the rustls crypto provider. Naive 'skip cert validation' implementations often return HandshakeSignatureValid::assertion() unconditionally for these methods, which means any party can impersonate the peer server without holding its private key -- the channel is encrypted but not authenticated. By delegating to the provider, the implementation retains proof-of-key-possession while relaxing only the CA chain trust requirement. Decision: custom verifier pins only the fingerprint; handshake signature verification is not weakened.
